title: What is Papertrade?
lead: Papertrade is a fair-launched, fully on-chain perpetuals exchange built on Hyperliquid, with several unique features:

title: Martingaler LP
lead: How Papertrade's LP bootstraps from zero with no upfront capital. A summary of the relevant parts of the Martin Galer whitepaper.

lead: Common questions about how Papertrade works, what it costs, and what's actually onchain.

title: Trades and pricing
lead: What a trade looks like from the trader's side, and where the price comes from.

title: Liquidations

title: Architecture overview
lead: The protocol is a set of contracts on the HyperEVM L1 that uses Hyperliquid's HyperCore precompiles for pricing and bridging. This page maps the contracts and how they fit together.

title: Pricing: BBO precompile
lead: Papertrade reads prices directly from Hyperliquid's native order book via an EVM precompile. No off-chain oracle, no pricing bot, no price signer.

title: Deposits: CREATE2 proxies
lead: Deposits work by sending USDC to a personal, per-user address. Whatever arrives there is credited to you: there is no deposit call to the Exchange and nothing to approve on it. It's the same model as a CEX deposit address, built on top of entirely on-chain mechanics.

title: Solvency & queue
lead: Papertrade's LP can be temporarily insolvent. A FIFO payout queue and a parked-funds side bucket guarantee winners eventually get paid, in order, while keeping the protocol from blocking new trades.

title: Asymmetric impact PnL
lead: How Papertrade settles closing PnL, where the protocol takes its cut of a trade.

title: Builder codes
lead: A planned 1% revenue share for frontends that originate trades. Not yet live.

title: Risk
lead: The main protocol-level risk surface is BBO price manipulation on Hyperliquid's order book. This page covers that unresolved vector, the contract's economic frictions and exposure controls, the operational guards on top, and the gated/public/admin surfaces.

title: $PAPER overview
lead: $PAPER is Papertrade's native token. It captures a share of protocol revenue when staked and is minted to traders against losing closes and liquidations.

title: PAPER mint curve
lead: The flat-then-ratchet curve that turns realised loss basis into PAPER supply. Early activity mints at a constant rate while tracked LP is underwater or small; later activity mints asymptotically less.

title: Staking & claims
lead: Stake PAPER, earn a pro-rata share of protocol revenue in USDC. Stake and unstake are both instant: no cooldown, no lockup.

title: Contract addresses
lead: Papertrade's contracts on HyperEVM mainnet (chain 999).
